summary: Iteration 17 — RE-VERIFY of the iteration-16 P0 Dress Me infinite render loop fix. VERDICT: FIXED. The dressme screen has been moved from `app/dressme.tsx` into `app/(tabs)/dressme.tsx` (a single, non-redirect real screen), the top-level `app/dressme.tsx` file has been deleted, and the tabPress listener + Redirect stub have been removed from `app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx`. Both P0 entrypoints now work with ZERO console errors: (1) Home hero button `home-dress-me-button` → navigates to /dressme, shows loading spinner then 'Perfect for Today' flat-lay of 4 resolved wardrobe items — 0 'Maximum update depth exceeded' errors; (2) 'Dress Me' bottom-tab item → same clean navigation, 0 loop errors. Full mini-flow also re-verified: `dressme-save` becomes 'Saved to My Outfits' (idempotent), the saved outfit appears in the Outfits tab under 'My Outfits' as `Dress Me · Tuesday, 21 Jul` and on Home 'Recent Outfits'. Swap sheet also re-verified: tapping `dressme-item-0` opens the 'Change <category>' modal, selecting a swap option closes the sheet and updates the flat-lay. No regressions detected on the entrypoints or the save/swap flow. Ready to ship.

critical_code_review_comments: app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx — clean now: no `useRouter()` at layout scope, no `listeners` intercept, dressme is a plain Tabs.Screen. Tab-press navigation is fully handled by expo-router's default behaviour (no infinite loop possible).

app/(tabs)/dressme.tsx — the real screen lives here. `started` ref + `useEffect(status !== 'idle' && !== 'loading')` correctly auto-runs generate() exactly once per mount. `generate` is memoised via useCallback so the effect deps are stable — no re-fire loop.

app/(tabs)/index.tsx L73-77 — `openDressMe` calls `router.push('/(tabs)/dressme')`. Note: URL bar shows `/dressme` after push because expo-router flattens the (tabs) group in the URL — this is expected/correct.
app/dressme.tsx has been deleted (verified via glob) — no more route ambiguity between top-level and (tabs) group.
Verified via console listener: 0 React warnings, 0 pageerror events, 0 'Maximum update depth exceeded' messages during both entrypoint tests.

rca_of_issue: Original iter-16 RCA remains authoritative. Applied fix (verified in place): (a) deleted `app/dressme.tsx`; (b) moved its full contents into `app/(tabs)/dressme.tsx` making the tab route the real screen; (c) removed `<Redirect>` stub; (d) removed `listeners={{tabPress: ...}}` from `<Tabs.Screen name='dressme'>` in _layout.tsx so it now uses expo-router's default tab-press behaviour; (e) updated Home hero to `router.push('/(tabs)/dressme')`. With only one route resolving to Dress Me and no listener re-triggering navigation, the setState-in-render loop that exhausted React's update budget is eliminated. Playwright verification captured 0 console errors of any kind across both entrypoints and the full save+swap flow.
